blocks.headline: In Hamburg
blocks.bodyGerman:
Foto A: der Bahnhof in Hamburg. In 8 Stunden nach Warschau. In 6 Stunden nach München. In 2 Stunden nach Berlin. Jeden Tag fahren hier 720 Züge.

Foto B: die Elbphilharmonie. Bauzeit: 9 Jahre, von 2007 bis 2016. Die Kosten: 866 Millionen Euro. Im ersten Jahr hat die Elbphilharmonie 4,5 Millionen Besucher.
blocks.bodyEnglish:
Photo A: the train station in Hamburg. 8 hours to Warsaw. 6 hours to Munich. 2 hours to Berlin. 720 trains run here every day.

Photo B: the Elbphilharmonie. Building took 9 years, from 2007 to 2016. Cost: 866 million euros. In the first year the Elbphilharmonie had 4.5 million visitors.

blocks.title: Die Elbphilharmonie
blocks.bodyEnglish: The Elbphilharmonie is a concert hall in Hamburg. Building it took nine years. It cost 866 million euros. In its first year it drew 4.5 million visitors and 600 concerts.

blocks.headline: Orte in Hamburg
blocks.bodyGerman: der Bahnhof | der Hafen | das Konzerthaus | die Kirche | das Rathaus
blocks.bodyEnglish: Five words for places in the city. Learn every noun with its article.

blocks.headline: der, die, das — der Artikel
blocks.bodyGerman: der Bahnhof | die Kirche | das Rathaus
blocks.bodyEnglish: Every German noun has an article: der, die or das. Say the article with the noun. The article tells you the gender of the noun.

blocks.explanationEnglish: German nouns have one of three articles: der (masculine), die (feminine), das (neuter). Learn the article together with the noun.
blocks.englishBridge: English uses a, an and the. German uses der, die and das.
blocks.targetSentenceGerman: Das ist der Bahnhof und das ist die Kirche.
blocks.targetSentenceEnglish: That is the train station and that is the church.

blocks.title: Nach einem Ort fragen
blocks.explanationEnglish: Ask what a place is. Answer with das ist and the noun with its article.

examples.german: Was ist das? Das ist der Bahnhof.
examples.english: What is that? That is the train station.

examples.german: Was ist das? Das ist das Rathaus.
examples.english: What is that? That is the town hall.

items.german: Das Rathaus ist über 120 Jahre alt.
items.english: The town hall is over 120 years old.
The town hall is 111 metres wide.

blocks.promptEnglish: Write: The town hall is over 120 years old.

blocks.explanationEnglish: Hafen is masculine. Masculine nouns take the article der.

concept.title: Artikel: der, die, das
concept.rule: Every noun has an article: der (masculine), die (feminine) or das (neuter).

blocks.prompt: Match the German place to the English word:
blocks.explanationEnglish: Every noun has an article. Learn der, das or die with the noun.
